response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and platforms, but lacks the mandatory 5–10 years of strong hands-on C++ development experience on Windows required for this role. While they have C++ experience (e.g., NI LabWindows/CVI), it is brief (2014–2015) and not recent or deep enough for a mid-senior C++ role in capital markets. No evidence of SQL Server/Oracle experience or fixed income/capital markets domain expertise.
strengths: Demonstrated software craftsmanship and adaptability across multiple languages and domains (C++, D, JavaScript, TypeScript, etc.)
Strong problem-solving skills evidenced by diverse projects (e.g., GISCollective, robotic arms, investment practices at RIDE Capital)
Experience with CI/CD, TDD, and modern development practices
concerns: Insufficient C++ experience (only ~1 year total, not recent or Windows-focused)
No clear experience with SQL Server or Oracle databases
No domain expertise in fixed income, investment banking, or capital markets
